theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_bvc_infinite_close_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Fs : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)), (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∃ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ k, ∃ i ∈ S, volume (symmDiff (Fs k) (Fs i) ∩ ball (0 : Euclid n) R) < ENNReal.ofReal θ) → ∀ (r : ℕ) (I : Set ℕ), I.Infinite → ∃ J ⊆ I, J.Infinite ∧ ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ l ∈ J, volume (symmDiff (Fs j) (Fs l) ∩ ball (0 : Euclid n) ((r : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
